definitions.gloss: splash; the sound of a single large object hitting water
definitions.explanation: An onomatopoeic word for a single, heavy splash — the sound and sensation of something (or someone) plunging into water with force.

examples.japanese: ざぶん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}んだ→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧。
examples.english: I plunged into the water with a splash.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざぶん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: A large rock fell into the river with a big splash.

examples.japanese: ⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{端|はじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}って→吸う：04394_suu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、ざぶん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}んだ→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧。
examples.english: She stood at the edge of the pool, took a deep breath, and then plunged in with a splash.

notes:
An onomatopoeia for a single heavy splash. Unlike the repeated ⟦ちゃぷちゃぷ→ちゃぷちゃぷ：29088_chapuchapu⟧ or ⟦ざぶざぶ→ざぶざぶ：05993_zabuzabu⟧, ざぶん captures one decisive impact with water.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ before a verb:
- ざぶん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}む→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧: to plunge in with a splash
- ざぶん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall in with a splash

RELATED WATER ONOMATOPOEIA:
- ⟦ちゃぷちゃぷ→ちゃぷちゃぷ：29088_chapuchapu⟧: gentle, rhythmic splashing
- ⟦ざぶざぶ→ざぶざぶ：05993_zabuzabu⟧: repeated heavy splashing (wading)
- どぼん: a heavy plop into water (slightly heavier, more hollow sound)
